newsitem.title: USA: Conrail halts talks over branch lines sale.
newsitem.headline: Conrail halts talks over branch lines sale.

text.p: Conrail Inc said Thursday it had "indefinitely" suspended negotiations with a prospective buyer over the sale of its branch lines in southern New Jersey.
Conrail also decided to retain ownership and operation of freight service in six clusters of lines it had previously planned to sell to short-line or regional railroads.
CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp are expected to unveil plans for their $10.3 billion acquisition of Conrail. Norfolk is to acquire more than half of the company's assets.
